obraz: Halfway up the hill the legs find a strength the flat road never asked for.
otevrene: whether the strength lasts to the top

obraz: After months of practice, you answer in the new language without translating first.
otevrene: who you answered and what you said

obraz: The potato forgotten in the cupboard has put out white shoots.
otevrene: whether it gets planted or thrown away

obraz: The bee leaves the clover carrying its dust to the next flower.
otevrene: what the next flower does with it

obraz: You turn down the praise and say whose work it was.
otevrene: whose work it was, why they went unnamed

obraz: The reply is written in a single breath, and your thumb stops above the send button.
otevrene: what the reply says, whether it is sent

obraz: The coins dropped in the jar each evening are, one day, the fare.
otevrene: the fare to where

obraz: The recipe card is in another hand, with one change added in yours.
otevrene: whose hand it was, what you changed

obraz: Halfway through the dishes a song comes on, and you both join in.
otevrene: who the other person is, which song

obraz: The child struggles with the zip, and you wait while they try again.
otevrene: whether the zip closes this time

obraz: The cold of the river at your ankles stops you before the current does.
otevrene: whether you cross

obraz: The umbrella turns inside out in the gust; you push it back and walk on.
otevrene: where you are walking to

obraz: The table has moved through three homes and still stands in the kitchen.
otevrene: who sat at it in the earlier homes

obraz: Dinner is burnt, and the table laughs over bread and cheese.
otevrene: who burnt it

obraz: The seedling droops for a week in its new pot, then puts out one leaf.
otevrene: whether it fully takes

obraz: Your foot is already off the kerb when the horn sounds.
otevrene: whether you step back in time

obraz: The tall grass lies flat in the wind and is standing again by evening.
The stream runs in the bed the old river cut.
znamy: no - needs knowledge of the valley's past; not an everyday moment
otevrene: where the old river went

obraz: On the first warm day every door on the street stands open.
The eider plucks her own down to line the nest.
znamy: no - known as a fact; few have watched a nesting eider

obraz: One person says the name no one has said all evening, and the table goes quiet.
otevrene: whose name, and why it went unsaid

obraz: The runner slows to a walk on the hill and does not stop.
You read the same message again in the morning, and it says something else.
otevrene: what it said at night, what it says now

obraz: The flight is cancelled at the gate, and the queue turns round as one.
otevrene: where everyone goes next

obraz: Two people walk side by side, and neither could say who set the pace.
otevrene: who the two are to each other

obraz: Said aloud, the plan sounds different from the one in your head.
otevrene: what the plan is, who hears it

obraz: A parcel sits on the step, taped shut, with no sender's name.
otevrene: what is inside, who sent it

obraz: You turn the map on your phone, and the street falls into place.
otevrene: where you are headed

obraz: A power cut ends the video call and takes the unsaved slide with it.
otevrene: what was on the slide

obraz: Two people carry a long mirror through the doorway, one pausing as the other turns.
The raven calls once from the roof, and everyone at the door looks up.
otevrene: why everyone was standing at the door

obraz: There is a recording of your own voice, and you cannot recall what it says.
otevrene: what the recording says

obraz: The tide has turned, and the same boats now point the other way.
One minute of hail, and the washing on the line is on the ground.
pravda: no - hail alone rarely knocks pegged washing down; it is the wind with it

obraz: Two swans cross the lake, and the gap between them never changes.
The path across the grass is on no plan; it is where everyone actually walks.
The tide pool at dusk moves once, and whatever moved does not show itself.
otevrene: what moved

obraz: A new document is open, and the cursor blinks on the first line.
otevrene: what is about to be written

obraz: The phone is at two per cent, and you send the one message that matters.
otevrene: what the message is, to whom

obraz: You hear your own phrase come out of a friend's mouth and learn how it sounds.
otevrene: what the phrase is, how it sounds

obraz: On the long drive you miss your turning because the road was so easy to follow.
The door opens on its chain, just far enough to see who is knocking.
otevrene: who is knocking

obraz: One wall in the new flat is still bare, without a single nail hole.
otevrene: what will hang there, why not yet

obraz: One seat is left on the last bus, and two of you are still on the pavement.
otevrene: who gets the seat

obraz: A friend copies the way you tap your foot, and you had never noticed it.
After the first hour of walking your feet stop asking how far it is.
otevrene: how far it still is

obraz: The phone is silenced for the night, with three numbers allowed to ring through.
otevrene: whose three numbers

obraz: Fresh snow lies on the field, and nothing has crossed it yet.
otevrene: who or what crosses first

obraz: The birch on the lava field grows no taller than the rock that shelters it.
znamy: no - a lava-field observation few have made themselves

obraz: In the dark window of the train your own face sits among the other passengers.
The phone light finds the dropped key, and beside it a long-lost earring.
otevrene: whose earring, how long it lay there

obraz: The geese feed with one head always raised.
otevrene: what the raised head is watching for

obraz: The candle kept for a special evening has never been lit.
otevrene: what evening would be special enough

obraz: The waterfall has become a wall of ice, its last streams held against the rock.
Your foot finds the brake as the car ahead drifts, before you know why.
otevrene: why the car ahead drifted

obraz: The new bulb in the hallway shows a crack that was always in the ceiling.
The cloud lifts, and you see how far up the slope you already are.
otevrene: how far is still left

obraz: The battery you never use is flat on the day you need it.
otevrene: what you needed it for

obraz: A chain of bubbles rises through the dark water, then stops beneath the clear ice.
znamy: no - few have looked down through clear lake ice
otevrene: what is sending the bubbles up

obraz: You turn back at the door, sure something is left behind, before you know what.
otevrene: what was left behind

obraz: One match in the cave shows the wall an arm's length away and no further.
otevrene: what lies beyond the light

obraz: The curtains open, and the colour you chose by lamplight is another colour.
The pool cut off from the river clouds over while the river runs clear.
A drop has frozen at the tip of an icicle, just before it falls.
The swell lifts the boat before any wave can be seen.
znamy: no - only people who go to sea know this
otevrene: what weather is behind the swell

obraz: You bring a dish to the shared dinner and leave with a plate of someone else's cooking.
The sun comes round to the window, and every fingerprint on the glass shows.
The lid holds, and holds, and gives under your grip.
The lift stops between floors, and the building goes on humming around it.
otevrene: how long, and who else is inside

obraz: The dough rests under a tea towel, and by morning it has doubled.
The borrowed book comes back with a bar of chocolate on top.
otevrene: who borrowed it

obraz: Everyone agreed in the corridor; on the form there is one name, and it is yours.
otevrene: what the form commits you to

obraz: The salmon climbs the falls one leap at a time.
The tree planted as a sapling beside the bench now shades the place where you sit.
otevrene: who planted it

obraz: The broken bone knits under the cast, and nothing can be seen of it.
Someone has remembered how you take your coffee.
otevrene: who remembered

obraz: You tell the referee the ball was out, and your own team loses the point.
otevrene: what the team says afterwards
